bio: Stephane is a solutions architect and software developer with a strong interest in Cloud & Big Data. He is a many-times best-selling instructor.
Recognized as an AWS Hero and AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional & DevOps Pro.
He loves to teach people how to use AWS properly and to prepare for certifications.
In spare time he enjoys cooking, yoga, surfing, and traveling to awesome destinations!

faq.q: In which order should you learn?
faq.a: Start with AWS Cloud Practitioner or AWS Solutions Architect Associate, then move to Developer Associate and SysOps. You can optionally add the AWS Certified AI Practitioner course.
